speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; have you noticed any specific patterns, such as scaling, blisters, or darkening of the skin in those areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given your occupation working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any skin lesions specifically on your hands, or have you experienced difficulty breathing or swallowing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). The combination of a pruritic rash on the face and upper body, sensory loss (numbness/tingling) in the palms, and specific signs like eyebrow thinning and eyelash loss is pathognomonic for leprosy.
